SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) as total_messages, COUNT(DISTINCT m.sender_id) as active_users, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) as total_participants, MAX(m.sent_at) as last_activity, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.message_type = 'FILE' THEN m.id END) as file_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.is_pinned = true THEN m.id END) as pinned_messages FROM chat_rooms r LEFT JOIN chat_messages m ON r.id = m.room_id LEFT JOIN chat_participants p ON r.id = p.room_id WHERE r.id = #{roomId} GROUP BY r.id

SELECT u.id as user_id, u.name as user_name, COUNT(m.id) as message_count, MAX(m.sent_at) as last_message_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.message_type = 'FILE' THEN m.id END) as file_count FROM users u JOIN chat_participants p ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN chat_messages m ON u.id = m.sender_id AND m.room_id = #{roomId} WHERE p.room_id = #{roomId} GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY message_count DESC

SELECT DATE(sent_at) as date, COUNT(*) as message_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sender_id) as active_users, COUNT(CASE WHEN message_type = 'FILE' THEN 1 END) as file_count FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND sent_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(sent_at) ORDER BY date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room_shares ( room_id, shared_by, share_type, share_token, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{sharedBy}, #{shareType}, #{shareToken}, #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_room_shares WHERE share_token = #{shareToken} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

SELECT r.*, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.tag_name) as tags, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.user_id) as participant_ids, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT m.id) as message_ids, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.file_path) as file_paths FROM chat_rooms r LEFT JOIN chat_room_tags t ON r.id = t.room_id LEFT JOIN chat_participants p ON r.id = p.room_id LEFT JOIN chat_messages m ON r.id = m.room_id LEFT JOIN chat_message_files f ON m.id = f.message_id WHERE r.id = #{roomId} GROUP BY r.id

SELECT m.*, u.name as sender_name, GROUP_CONCAT(f.file_path) as file_paths FROM chat_messages m JOIN users u ON m.sender_id = u.id LEFT JOIN chat_message_files f ON m.id = f.message_id WHERE m.room_id = #{roomId} GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY m.sent_at
SELECT p.*, u.name as user_name, u.email as user_email FROM chat_participants p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.room_id = #{roomId}

SELECT DATE(sent_at) as date, HOUR(sent_at) as hour, COUNT(*) as message_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sender_id) as unique_senders, AVG(LENGTH(message)) as avg_message_length, COUNT(CASE WHEN message_type = 'FILE' THEN 1 END) as file_count FROM chat_messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND sent_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(sent_at), HOUR(sent_at) ORDER BY date, hour

SELECT u.id as user_id, u.name as user_name, COUNT(m.id) as total_messages, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(m.sent_at)) as active_days, AVG(LENGTH(m.message)) as avg_message_length, COUNT(CASE WHEN m.message_type = 'FILE' THEN 1 END) as file_count, MAX(m.sent_at) as last_message_time FROM users u JOIN chat_messages m ON u.id = m.sender_id WHERE m.room_id = #{roomId} GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY total_messages DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_reads (message_id, user_id, read_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT m.id as message_id, m.sender_id, m.message, m.sent_at, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) as total_participants, COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) as read_count, (COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id)) as unread_count FROM chat_messages m JOIN chat_participants p ON m.room_id = p.room_id LEFT JOIN chat_reads r ON m.id = r.message_id AND r.user_id = p.user_id WHERE m.id = #{messageId} AND p.user_id != m.sender_id -- 발신자 제외 GROUP BY m.id, m.sender_id, m.message, m.sent_at
SELECT r.user_id, u.name as user_name, r.read_at FROM chat_reads r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.message_id = #{messageId} ORDER BY r.read_at ASC

SELECT p.user_id, u.name as user_name, COUNT(m.id) as unread_count, MIN(m.sent_at) as first_unread_at FROM chat_participants p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id JOIN chat_messages m ON m.room_id = p.room_id WHERE p.room_id = #{roomId} AND m.sender_id != p.user_id -- 본인이 보낸 메시지 제외 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_reads r WHERE r.message_id = m.id AND r.user_id = p.user_id ) GROUP BY p.user_id, u.name ORDER BY unread_count DESC
